warning: Marker positions are approximate locators digitised from the written rule, not legal boundaries. Fis 306.01 and the Fish and Game closed-area maps are the only authority. Check them before you hunt.
source: N.H. Admin. Code Fis 306.01, Areas Closed to Hunting (amended effective 21 Aug 2023), plus the NH Fish and Game closed-area PDF.

areas.d: Closed to waterfowl hunting from the former cement bridge at the south end of Lake Winnisquam downstream to Silver Lake.
Closed to waterfowl hunting along the eastern shore within a 300-yard band, from the power dam to the point south of the Gardners Grove entrance, and in all of Gardners Grove.

areas.n: Squam River — Big to Little Squam
areas.d: The river between Big and Little Squam Lakes is closed to all waterfowl hunting, plus 300 yards of adjacent land.

areas.n: Squam River — Little Squam to Ashland
areas.d: Closed to all waterfowl hunting, plus 300 yards of adjacent land.

areas.n: Big Squam Lake incl. Cotton Cove
areas.d: Closed to ALL hunting south of a line from Kusumpee Point to the northeast tip of Pine Point and the mouth of White Oak Brook. The area between White Oak Brook and the Squam River north of Route 3 is also closed, with 300 yards of adjacent land.
Pickerel Cove and the area of Paugus Bay within a 300-yard radius of its mouth are closed to waterfowl hunting.

Several areas are closed to waterfowl hunting: south of the Winnisquam (Mosquito) Bridge through Mohawk Island; the eastern shore south of Mohawk Island including Sun Ray Canal and Back/Tucker Pond; the eastern shore north of Mosquito Bridge to Loon Island, with an exception near Hueber's sawmill; and all areas north of Loon Island. Each zone extends 300 yards into the lake from the shoreline.
The pond and the wetland created by the Beaver Brook dam at Kendall Pond Road are closed to all bird and waterfowl hunting, plus 300 yards of adjacent land.
Closed to taking waterfowl.
A defined rectangular area off Gulf Road is closed to all hunting.
Closed to waterfowl hunting, plus 300 yards of adjacent land. The boundary runs from the western end of Scammell Bridge on Route 4, around Goat Island, and back to Route 4.
Closed to all bird and waterfowl hunting, including the adjacent wetlands.

The entire cove, on the Durham/Newmarket town line, is closed to taking waterfowl. The closure includes a 300-foot perimeter at the outer tip of the Durham peninsula and 300 feet along the southern shore of the Newmarket peninsula.
The entire cove is closed to taking waterfowl. The closure includes a 300-foot perimeter at the tip of the northern peninsula and 300 feet adjacent to the northern boundary of Hilton State Park.
Closed to waterfowl hunting from the mouth of Chase Brook north about 1,200 yards to the northernmost tip of the northernmost island in Litchfield.

areas.n: Piscataqua River — Gen. Sullivan to Sarah Long
areas.d: Closed to waterfowl hunting from the General Sullivan Bridge in Newington downstream to the Sarah Mildred Long Bridge in Portsmouth.

Closed to all hunting in a defined area running from south of the quarter-mile marker across the pond to the parking lot point in Somersworth. The closure includes waters toward the Route 9/108 intersection and the Fish and Game boat access site.
Waters at the high tide line from New Bellamy Road north to the northernmost point of Nute Road are closed to waterfowl hunting.
Closed to all hunting on property bordering Great Pond, from the Ball Road bridge to where the river drains into Great Pond. The Great Pond waterbody itself is excluded.
The tidal water between the New Castle and Wentworth bridges, including the nearby islands, is closed to all duck hunting and to discharging a firearm.

refuge.d: Waterfowl hunting is allowed only along designated stretches of refuge shoreline, shown on the refuge waterfowl hunt map. Access is by boat launched from off-refuge sites only — overland access through the refuge is prohibited, and you may not enter closed areas to retrieve downed birds. No refuge permit is needed for waterfowl, and waterfowl hunting is outside the deer and turkey lottery. Dogs are allowed only for waterfowl retrieval. Baiting and trapping are prohibited. State and federal regulations apply.
